name: Figma
tagline: Figma is the dominant collaborative design tool used by product teams worldwide for UI/UX design, prototyping, and design system management. Its AI features, including First Draft (layout generation), Auto Layout, and plugin-based AI tools, accelerate the path from idea to interactive prototype. Designers, product managers, and engineers all work inside Figma, making it the single source of design truth.
